simple.meaning: כִּיר (kîyr) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a cooking range (consisting of two parallel stones, across which the boiler is set).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H3600. kir [ כִּיר ] noun [masculine] cooking-furnace (Mishna כִּירָה ) — frangible, only dual כִּירַיִם Lev 11:35 (with תַּנּזּר ), perhaps as supporting two pots (Ki); ᵐ5 χυτρόποδες .
